"""Camera-calibrated controller for the single live episode. No simulator state used."""
import sys, os, json, time, traceback
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras'])
root='/app/output'; counter=0

def capture():
 global obs,q,target
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True)
 q=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:29]); target=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][58:87])
 return obs

def save(tag='view'):
 global counter
 counter+=1
 path=f'/app/runs/{counter:03d}_{tag}'
 obs.save(path)
 canvas=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
 for i,c in enumerate(cams):
  Image.fromarray(obs.last[c]).save(f'{root}/{c}.png')
  canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(obs.last[c]),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
 canvas.resize((1280,960)).save(f'{root}/views.png')
 np.savez(f'{root}/obs.npz',**{c:obs.last[c] for c in cams},**{c+'_depth':obs.depth[c] for c in obs.depth})
 open(root+'/meta.json','w').write(json.dumps(obs.meta))
 print('saved',path,'task',obs.meta['task'],'time',obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)

def move(a,seconds=1.,tag='move'):
 global obs,q,target
 a=np.asarray(a)
 if a.ndim==1:a=a[None,:]
 np.save(f'{root}/action_{counter:03d}.npy',a)
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=seconds/len(a),cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames',video_fps=5)
 q=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:29]);target=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][58:87])
 save(tag)
 return obs

def cloud(cam):
 dep=obs.depth[cam].astype(float); rgb=obs.last[cam]
 cal=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])
 v,u=np.indices(dep.shape)
 local=np.stack(((u-K[0,2])*dep/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*dep/K[1,1],-dep),-1)
 return local@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3],rgb

def handcloud():
 ps=[]
 for c in cams:
  p,col=cloud(c)
  mask=(p[:,:,2]>.66)&(p[:,:,2]<.86)&(p[:,:,1]<.20)&(p[:,:,1]>-.2)&(p[:,:,0]>-.20)&(p[:,:,0]<.15)&(col.min(2)>95)&(col.max(2)-col.min(2)<45)
  ps.append(p[mask])
 return np.concatenate(ps)

def rigid(A,B):
 ac=A.mean(0);bc=B.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((A-ac).T@(B-bc)); R=Vt.T@U.T
 if np.linalg.det(R)<0:Vt[-1]*=-1;R=Vt.T@U.T
 T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=R;T[:3,3]=bc-R@ac;return T

def trans(T,p):return p@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]

def icp(A,B,T=None,n=60,cut=.025):
 T=np.eye(4) if T is None else T.copy(); tree=cKDTree(B)
 for k in range(n):
  P=trans(T,A); d,ix=tree.query(P); keep=d<cut
  # trim outlying unmatched surfaces
  keep &= d<np.quantile(d,.90)
  D=rigid(P[keep],B[ix[keep]]);T=D@T
  if np.linalg.norm(D-np.eye(4))<1e-7:break
 return T,np.sqrt(np.mean(d[keep]**2))

capture();save('start')
print('READY',flush=True)
while True:
 if os.path.exists(root+'/command.py'):
  src=open(root+'/command.py').read();os.unlink(root+'/command.py')
  with open(root+'/executed.py','a') as f:f.write('\n# command\n'+src+'\n')
  try:exec(compile(src,'command','exec'),globals())
  except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
  open(root+'/ready','w').write('ready')
 time.sleep(.1)
